Evidence & scope

Scoped methods, data-collection or experiment claims were read from the exact pinned preprint version by separate author, source-verifier and adversarial AI invocations. The full cited contexts, including conditions and model/table identities, are bound to approved observations; actual partial/full/unread scopes are retained in review records. This is not a complete-paper, latest-version, corpus, proof, labor, supplier-performance or experiment-reproduction audit. Work and version remain distinct and contribute at most one reviewed paper work.

Approved findings

Approved evidence · As of 10 Nov 2026

STAMP Your Content: Proving Dataset Membership via Watermarked Rephrasings (2504.13416v2) · paper method: STAMP requires watermarking before online release and access to model token probabilities; it does not retroactively mark previously published content.

cohort8.claim.stamp.access-timing

  • Original author-stage note: Author-only candidate: separate source-verifier and adversarial source-content reviews remain pending.
  • Version-specific primary-source report. Proofs, model experiments, underlying data, consent/pay records and supplier participation have not been independently reproduced or audited.
  • The paper also warns about paraphrase errors and evaluates continual pretraining rather than models trained from scratch.

Approved evidence · As of 10 Nov 2026

STAMP Your Content: Proving Dataset Membership via Watermarked Rephrasings (2504.13416v2) · paper method: The method uses a one-sided paired t-test for lower public-version perplexity relative to private versions.

cohort8.claim.stamp.one-sided-test

  • Original author-stage note: Author-only candidate: separate source-verifier and adversarial source-content reviews remain pending.
  • Version-specific primary-source report. Proofs, model experiments, underlying data, consent/pay records and supplier participation have not been independently reproduced or audited.
  • Before testing, the method clips the top 5% outliers as described on physical p3 lines65–68; no derivation or false-positive guarantee was independently verified.

Approved evidence · As of 10 Nov 2026

STAMP Your Content: Proving Dataset Membership via Watermarked Rephrasings (2504.13416v2) · paper method: STAMP compares a public keyed paraphrase collection with privately held differently keyed paraphrases using paired perplexity differences.

cohort8.claim.stamp.paired-design

  • Original author-stage note: Author-only candidate: separate source-verifier and adversarial source-content reviews remain pending.
  • Version-specific primary-source report. Proofs, model experiments, underlying data, consent/pay records and supplier participation have not been independently reproduced or audited.
  • The null depends on the randomized keyed-generation design; the statistical claim does not establish arbitrary unmarked content membership.

Approved evidence · As of 10 Nov 2026

STAMP Your Content: Proving Dataset Membership via Watermarked Rephrasings (2504.13416v2) · paper method: STAMP can compare each public paraphrase against the average perplexity over multiple differently keyed private paraphrases to reduce individual-document bias.

cohort8.claim.stamp.private-keys

  • Original author-stage note: Author-only candidate: separate source-verifier and adversarial source-content reviews remain pending.
  • Version-specific primary-source report. Proofs, model experiments, underlying data, consent/pay records and supplier participation have not been independently reproduced or audited.
  • Private-key count is a hyperparameter; detection strength depends on it and on collection/training conditions.
